definitions.explanation: The criminal act of threatening someone in order to obtain money, property, or other advantages. A specific legal term in Japanese criminal law.

examples.japanese: {恐喝|きょうかつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{恐喝|きょうかつ}⟦{未遂|みすい}→未遂：13085_misui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容疑|ようぎ}→容疑：12317_yougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{取|と}り{調|しら}べ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: He was questioned on suspicion of attempted extortion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{暴露|ばくろ}する→暴露する：18209_bakurosuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧{恐喝|きょうかつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Cases of extortion by threatening to expose company secrets are increasing.

notes:
A legal term for a specific category of crime under the Japanese Penal Code (⟦{刑法|けいほう}→刑法：15210_keihou⟧). {恐喝罪|きょうかつざい} (the crime of extortion) involves using intimidation to extract money or property from a victim. More specific than ⟦{脅迫|きょうはく}→脅迫：27205_kyouhaku⟧, which covers threats in general. Can be used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a suru-verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恐喝|きょうかつ}{罪|ざい}: the crime of extortion
- {恐喝|きょうかつ}⟦{未遂|みすい}→未遂：13085_misui⟧: attempted extortion
- {恐喝|きょうかつ}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: extortion case
- {恐喝|きょうかつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容疑|ようぎ}→容疑：12317_yougi⟧: suspicion of extortion
- {恐喝|きょうかつ}{犯|はん}: extortionist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脅迫|きょうはく}→脅迫：27205_kyouhaku⟧: threat; intimidation — the broader act of threatening; does not necessarily involve demanding money
- {強請|ゆす}り: extortion; shakedown — a more colloquial term for extortion
- ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧: fraud; swindling — obtaining money through deception rather than threats
- ⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧: robbery — taking property by force, not through threats alone
